full_page.content:
1942, January 1
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, 0.7 .M.Cap.
Jan 1, 1942
Mr. Owen B. J. Casey 756 - 9th Ave San Francisco, California My Dear Brother Owen and Family:
St. Bonaventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave Detroit, Mich.
God bless you and yours. I was fixing up a certain cell yesterday when this card showed up. It reminded me of our visit some thirty months back when you served the high Mass and the sisters inside sang - and ... after breakfast, we had a conference with the prisoners of Jesus.
Quite some changes since those pleasant few days .... Many thanks Martha for your beautiful card, etc. I wanted to answer it again and again ..... We have not heard from Fr. Edward since September nor from Guam - first taken by the Japs - since before the trouble .... I think it best to be, not over anxious about whats coming. One thing we may be sure of - God is watching all and in His own time and way will turn all to His glory and ours in as much as we shall persevered in His service. It seems to me it is once more "history repeating itself as against sins"Thou shalt not comit adultery" ..... Happy New Year.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(Postcard of Monastery of the Blessed Sacrament in Detroit)
